label: main season
summary: Recommend further non-technical survey. The only logged evidence is a second-hand report that use of the pasture edge stopped after an armed group camped there; it is indirect evidence (reliability class 5), not enough to establish a clearance target after one visit. There is also insufficient qualifying evidence of safe use to cancel. Follow up the report and seek reliable information from people who know and use the land.
flags: The reported camp and cessation of use date to around 2006; clarify the source and circumstances in a further visit.
The zone flag and survey priority indicate where to survey, not evidence of EO.

checks.detail: Further non-technical survey is always open.

E1.quote: A teacher said people stopped using the land at the edge of the pasture after an armed group camped there around 2006, and nobody has used it since.
E1.note: This is a second-hand verbal report linking disuse to an armed group's camp; it suggests possible contamination but does not confirm EO or provide evidence of safe use.
